description: Per beta, every map start ranked by the path-integral T_death (see wpa_rate docstring); 'best' is the start the long run uses.

0.8500.note: best: largest path-integral T_death. best_by_measured_rate: lowest measured windowed Gamma over the map run (floored at 2 sigma), no interpolation. The long stage runs both.

1.3333.note: best: largest path-integral T_death. best_by_measured_rate: lowest measured windowed Gamma over the map run (floored at 2 sigma), no interpolation. The long stage runs both.
